notes.title: Patch 4.1
notes.content:
This patch includes small adjustments to playable characters in survival and boss rush modes,
and new audios in a couple of story mode cutscenes.

notes.title: small update
notes.content:
This small update fixes some texts that still needed localization (a small amount of texts are still missing, sorry)

and also allows the player to obtain the last treasure of the white cloaks that could not be obtained.

notes.title: Patch 3.0
notes.content:
This Patch adds several things:

[list]
[*] Survive and Boss Rush mode are available to anybody who has beat the game
[*] New achivements for these new modes
[*] Fixed and more clear first tutorial level
[*] New voices for some of the cutscenes
[/list]

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content: This patch fixes an audio volume error on a display

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: this update adds some fields in localization that weren't available before, as well as some new audio for some of the cutscenes

notes.title: Update 2.6
notes.content: This update fixes details of the character's lag on strong attack and fixes the translation of the mask museum items.

notes.title: Mini patch 2.2.6.1
notes.content: This patch Fixes a small error in wich an achievement couldn't be unlocked.

notes.title: Update 2.2.5
notes.content:
With this update we patch some errors that prevented some trophies from being obtained.

[list]
[*]The last 4 art books can be purchased at the mask museum
[*]A comic was unobtainable in the base game, we have added it to one of the tunnels
[*]An Letter from Evangeline could be lost if you didn't get it from its original location, since after a point in the game you can never go back there.
[*] Some of Dr Sitho's dialogues did not appear correctly with the translation
[/list]

notes.title: Koatl and the Lost Tunnels Update 2.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We bring you a small update of Koatl and the lost tunnels, in this update you will find the following:

[list]
[*]translation of Dr. Sitho's shop regarding buy and sell options
[*]Artbook button translation settings
[*]Translation of the pause menu in Spanish and English
[*]The Second Prologue of the Game when Julian becomes Koatl now has voices!
[/list]

Thank you very much for continuing to support the game, we will continue to update it!
